label: air temperature
definition: Temperature of the air around the feature of interest, at the height where it was measured.

label: cell length
definition: Length of a cell along its longest axis.

label: cell width
definition: Width of a cell, measured at right angles to its length.

label: depth
definition: Distance below a reference surface, such as the ground or the water surface, at which a sample was taken or a value measured.

label: fire return interval
definition: Average time between fires at a site or in an area.

label: growth temperature
definition: Temperature at which an organism grows.

label: microbial biomass carbon
definition: Carbon held in living microbial biomass, per unit mass of soil or sediment.

label: nitrate concentration
definition: Amount of nitrate per unit volume or mass of a sample.

label: pH
definition: Acidity or alkalinity of a sample on the pH scale.

label: pressure
definition: Force per unit area, such as the pressure at which an organism grows or a sample was collected.

label: projected shoot area
definition: Area of a plant shoot as seen in a two-dimensional image.

label: salinity
definition: Concentration of dissolved salts in water or another medium.

label: sample storage temperature
definition: Temperature at which a sample was stored before analysis.

label: soil organic carbon content
definition: Organic carbon per unit mass of soil.

label: soil phosphate content
definition: Phosphate per unit mass of soil.

label: temperature
definition: Temperature of the feature of interest, when the medium is not part of the property.

label: total carbon
definition: All carbon, organic and inorganic, per unit mass or volume of a sample.

label: water temperature
definition: Temperature of a body of water, or of water at a point in it.
